items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: I think, as a matter of fact, I probably first met him in New York. And then back here later.

ctx.x: I think, as a matter of fact, I probably first met him in New York. And then back here later. Uh, we were talking about, uh, Tony Perennis from New Orleans. Yes. Isn't he? Yes. I can't remember how early I knew him anymore.

Well, Tony, uh... In the 30s was with Ted Lewis, and earlier was with, uh, in radio work at New York. But I don't think that he came north. Until about 30. In other words, he wasn't in the firsts. Um... There was a trumpet player by the name of Lopez.
